title: The Class Pet
scene: A primary school classroom corner where children take turns caring for the class rabbit, while one child forgets and the water bottle is empty.
questions: What are the children in this picture doing?
How do you think the rabbit is feeling? Why?
Have you ever looked after an animal? Tell me about it.
What might happen if everyone forgot their turn?
Why is it important to keep a promise, even a small one?
